meta.name: pr-submit
meta.description: Agent-side signal to captain that your branch is ready for PR landing. Runs preconditions (clean tree, pushed, matching QGR receipt) then dispatches captain with a structured payload. Captain's /pr-captain-land picks it up. Replaces the distributed "agent creates PR" model with a captain-owned PR lifecycle (the-agency#296).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动执行 PR 提交前置检查并通知负责人
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果团队使用 captain 主导的 PR 生命周期。
copy.tagline_en: Automate PR submission precondition checks and notify the captain
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your team uses a captain-owned PR lifecycle.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会检查你的分支是否满足合并 PR 的前置条件（工作目录干净、已推送、有质量保证收据）。如果满足，它会向指挥官发送“PR 就绪”通知，由指挥官负责后续的 PR 创建、版本升级和合并等操作。
howto.when: 当你成功运行 /pr-prep 并将分支推送到远程后，对 Claude 输入 /pr-submit 命令时触发。注意，不能从 master/main 分支执行。

say.note: Claude 会检查条件，符合则通知指挥官
Claude 将检查并通知指挥官

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will check your branch for PR landing preconditions (clean tree, pushed, matching QGR receipt). If satisfied, it sends a "ready for PR landing" dispatch to the captain, who then handles PR creation, version bump, and merge.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you run /pr-submit command after a successful /pr-prep and your branch is pushed to origin. Not from master/main checkout.

say_en.note: Claude checks conditions then notifies captain
Claude will check and notify captain
